figure_review.caption_finding: none: the caption states what each panel measures (equally-weighted cumulative curves, logarithmic horizontal axis, bar comparison of component-pattern descriptions by key) and points the reader at the numeric tables below, so it does not merely repeat a title
figure_review.caption_judged: read to establish context only; the visual verdicts below are taken from the rendered PNG, not from the SVG or its markup

rubric_items.contrast: pass: all text — tick labels, axis labels, legend entries, direct value labels and category labels — is dark on a white background at full strength, with no coloured or lightened text anywhere.
rubric_items.data_ink: pass: the plotted lines and the two bars are the dominant ink; the panels carry no gridlines, no background fill and no shading, and every mark stands for a measured quantity (the 1,802 and 413 labels match the run's recorded field_patterns and category_patterns, and the blue curve's 12 % intercept at x=1 matches 3,338 singleton component groups of 27,253).
rubric_items.decoration: pass: no gradient, no background fill, no styled theme and no decorative annotation; top and right spines are absent on both panels and only the axes that carry a scale remain.
rubric_items.label_collision: pass: no text is clipped at any canvas edge and no text overlaps another or the data — the figure-level legend sits in clear space above the left panel, the '1,802' and '413' labels sit above their bars in empty space, and both the 10^4 tick label and the right panel's category labels render fully inside the canvas.
rubric_items.legibility: pass: at the rendered width both panels read at a glance — the left panel is a two-series cumulative group-size distribution on a logarithmic axis from 10^0 to 10^4 with y ticks at 0/25/50/75/100 %, axis labels 'variables per group' and 'groups at or below size [%]', and a two-entry legend identifying 'control nodes' (dashed grey) and 'components' (solid blue); the right panel compares two labelled count categories, 'category + fields' at 1,802 and 'category only' at 413, with the values written directly above each bar and the y axis labelled 'pattern descriptions'.
rubric_items.table_form: pass: the image depicts a distribution and a magnitude comparison rather than rows of values; the right panel is a two-category comparison where the relative heights carry the values at a glance, and the caption directs readers to the numeric tables for the exact totals.
